# 1_26

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--champ">champion</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">complete</span>

## Scorecard

10-aircraft MXP trombone, the fixed 100-seed pool, deterministic. **Success** = tier 5: every aircraft landed within ±60 s of its AMAN target, no loss of separation. Clean-subset success = success among episodes without a loss of separation.

A separate per-seed scoring of the same checkpoint (`analysis/2026-08-17_1_26_at10M_perseed.csv`) gives success 0.69, separation 0.08, worst-aircraft deviation 41.3 s: the 10-aircraft scorer does not pin the observation frame, so repeat scorings move by a few seeds.

Paired against `1_25` on success, per seed: 32 gained, 7 lost (significant, McNemar).

**Attempts to solve** (stochastic retries until solved, cap 20): deterministic 0.63, pass@1 0.56, pass@5 0.75, pass@10 0.79, pass@20 0.82; never solved 18. Source: `analysis/2026-08-11_1_26_attempts_100seeds/attempts_per_seed.csv`.
